ownership_graph.root: May admit only document-manager and may not inspect document files.
ownership_graph.top_manager: Owns directory decomposition, may admit only ab-document-manager and gamma-document-manager, and may not inspect document files.
ownership_graph.subgroup_managers: Own disjoint file groups, may admit only their named terminal file workers, and may not inspect document files.
ownership_graph.leaves: Each owns and reads exactly one Markdown file and reports only to its direct parent.
ownership_graph.required_success_path: root -> document-manager -> subgroup manager -> terminal file worker

p_plus.selector: Choose the first attempt satisfying the answer-free structural eligibility rule; if none is eligible, choose the first attempt.

required_before_full_bank: P selects hierarchical and admits document-manager plus both subgroup managers but does not complete the terminal leaf layer
P+ executes the exact six-admission D3 graph and passes answer and clean protocol gates

p_requirements: top manager and both subgroup managers admitted
terminal leaf layer blocked or incomplete under the depth-two cap
p_plus_requirements: exact root -> top manager -> two subgroup managers -> three terminal leaves graph executed
all direct-parent reports delivered exactly once

interpretation_boundary: A pass establishes that extra recursive depth expands reachable system capability. It does not establish that the structural gap can be compressed into a depth-two deployment policy. No policy update follows directly from this screen.
